remarks: Located at the end of a cul-de-sac and perfectly sited on a level .56 property this home is very convenient to downtown Westport, Compo Beach, Longshore and transportation. Interior freshly painted, renovated baths and filled with light, this pristine home has a LR w/ FP, DR with sliders opening to the rear deck and kitchen on the main level. The upper level includes the MBR w/ bath and three additional bedrooms with hall bath. The lower level has a family room, half bath and a laundry area. Two large decks provide ample space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation, while the flat, spacious backyard adds even more versatility for outdoor activities.
